appraisal_events.evidence: cet homme petit... connu, paraît-il, à Londres aussi bien qu'à Monte-Carlo, pour un des premiers hôteliers de l'Europe... ses yeux étincelants... voyaient tout, réglaient tout... Il se sentait évidemment plus que metteur en scène, que chef d'orchestre, véritable généralissime.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator's description builds the hotel director into an almost supreme, all-seeing commanding figure whose authority over the restaurant is total, while lesser guests (including the narrator) receive only a cold, ambiguous greeting compared to the deep deference shown to important clients.

appraisal_events.evidence: depuis qu'elle était amie d'une personnalité de la cuisine... Françoise... n'osait pas sonner; elle assurait que ce serait mal vu... nous ne pouvions plus avoir d'eau chaude parce que Françoise était devenue l'amie de celui qui la faisait chauffer.
appraisal_events.explanation: Françoise's cultivated loyalty to fellow hotel servants comes to outweigh her duty to the grandmother and narrator, so that their simple household requests are now refused or delayed for the sake of Françoise's own social bonds.

status_effects.explanation: He is portrayed as commanding near-total, quasi-military authority over the hotel and its dinner service, a status well above an ordinary employee.
The narrator is intimidated and made to feel insignificant, receiving a cold greeting he cannot distinguish from disdain, in contrast to the profound deference shown to important guests.
She is locally excluded from having her basic needs met (hot water) because Françoise now prioritizes her own relations among the hotel staff.
Françoise gains standing and inclusion within the hotel servants' own social circle, a status she now privileges over service to her employers.

ambiguities: The narrator explicitly cannot tell whether the director's cold greeting reflects mere professional reserve or disdain for an unimportant client, which qualifies how strongly the narrator's status effect should be read.
